title: paspalum sanguinale var. timorense
intro: Paspalum sanguinale var. timorense, commonly known as blood grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, thus providing potential health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and preventing atherosclerosis. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum sanguinale var. timorense include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator, which can help in reducing oxidative stress and improving blood flow. The bioactive constituents of Paspalum sanguinale var. timorense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other phytochemicals, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
